materials.name: cobble_granite
materials.desc: Rounded grey-buff granite cobbles in irregular courses, tight sandy joints, foot-polished crowns. THE square paving. special = wet sheen.

materials.name: sett_basalt
materials.desc: Dark blue-grey rectangular basalt setts in running bond, crisp but worn. Roadways, gutters, kerb aprons. special = wet.

materials.name: flagstone_york
materials.desc: Large warm buff sandstone flags, random rectangular coursing, lipped and cracked. Pavements, terraces, thresholds. special = moss in joints.

materials.name: gravel
materials.desc: Fine packed gravel and dirt. Yard corners, planting beds, under benches. special = wet.

materials.name: soil
materials.desc: Dark crumbly planting soil with bits of bark. Inside pots and planters. special = wet.

materials.name: ashlar_limestone
materials.desc: Coursed dressed pale limestone blocks with fine lime joints, tooled faces. Plinths, civic walls, tower bases. special = moss.

materials.name: rubble_fieldstone
materials.desc: Random rubble wall of mixed grey/ochre field stones in deep recessed mortar. Retaining walls, cellars, back walls. special = moss.

materials.name: brick_red
materials.desc: Old hand-made red clay brick, running bond (225x75 mm module), lime mortar, colour variation and spalling. special = moss/efflorescence.

materials.name: brick_ochre
materials.desc: Buff/yellow stock brick with dark headers and sooty faces, Flemish-ish bond. special = lichen.

materials.name: stone_smooth
materials.desc: Fine-grained dressed stone face without joints, subtle tooling and veining. Use on individually modelled blocks: sills, copings, fountain bowls, steps, quoins, statues. Tintable (default warm grey limestone). special = moss.

materials.name: stone_rough
materials.desc: Rough-hewn / split stone face without joints, pitted and chiselled. Kerbs, bollards, rubble blocks, boulders, plinth courses. Tintable. special = moss.

materials.name: slate
materials.desc: Riven blue-black slate with cleavage ridges. Individually modelled roof slates, hearths, chalk-free sign boards. Tintable. special = lichen.

materials.name: mortar
materials.desc: Plain sandy lime mortar / render fill. Behind modelled stones, pointing, cement patches. Tintable. special = moss.

materials.name: plaster_lime
materials.desc: Hand-trowelled lime plaster / limewash: soft undulation, trowel arcs, hairline cracks, faint patch repairs. Tintable (white base - pick any wall colour). wear = plaster chipped to pale substrate; special = damp/algae staining.

materials.name: plaster_rough
materials.desc: Coarse roughcast / stucco with aggregate, flaking patches. Tintable (white base). Back streets, upper storeys, chimneys. special = damp/algae.

materials.name: roof_tile_clay
materials.desc: Overlapping hand-made plain clay roof tiles in courses (eaves at V=0, ridge towards +V). Terracotta reds/oranges, moss in laps. For distant / large roofs; hero roofs should model tiles with 'terracotta'. special = moss.

materials.name: roof_slate
materials.desc: Coursed blue-grey roof slates, staggered, some slipped / chipped (eaves at V=0). special = lichen.

materials.name: wood_shingle
materials.desc: Split cedar shingles in courses, silvered and cupped (eaves at V=0). Turrets, porches, stall roofs. special = moss.

materials.name: copper_patina
materials.desc: Weathered copper sheet: brown oxide to streaky verdigris green (the special mask pushes it fully green). Domes, turret caps, flashing, gutters. Plain sheet without seams - model the standing seams.

materials.name: wood_oak
materials.desc: Sawn oak, warm mid brown, visible straight grain with rays and the odd knot. Single continuous board (no seams): model your own planks. Tintable for stains (e.g. #6b4a2e dark, #3a2a1e tarred beam, #c8a070 fresh). wear = pale bare wood.

materials.name: wood_weathered
materials.desc: Silver-grey weathered softwood: raised grain, checks and splits, nail stains. Crates, fences, cart beds, shutters left unpainted. Tintable. special = moss/algae.

materials.name: wood_painted
materials.desc: Brush-painted timber: faint grain telegraphing, brush strokes, drips. Tintable (white base - choose the paint colour). The WEAR mask chips the paint back to grey-brown wood, special = sun-fade. Doors, shutters, window frames, shopfronts, signs, benches.

materials.name: wood_planks
materials.desc: Tongue-and-groove board cladding: ~125 mm boards running along U with seams, nail heads, slight cupping. For big boarded surfaces you do not model plank-by-plank (stall backs, attic gables, doors' inner faces). Tintable. special = moss.

materials.name: wood_endgrain
materials.desc: End grain: growth rings and radial checks. Beam ends, log ends, barrel heads' edges, chopping blocks. Tintable.

materials.name: bark
materials.desc: Deeply furrowed grey-brown tree bark, ridges running along V (up the trunk). Tree trunks and branches. special = moss/lichen.

materials.name: wicker
materials.desc: Woven willow basketry: horizontal weavers over vertical stakes (U horizontal). Baskets, hampers, chair seats, cloches. Tintable.

materials.name: iron_wrought
materials.desc: Hand-forged black iron: hammer facets, fire scale, blackened/oiled finish. Brackets, scrolls, railings, hinges, lantern frames, chains. wear = burnished bright steel; special = rust.

materials.name: iron_painted
materials.desc: Thickly painted cast iron: sand-cast orange-peel under glossy paint, chips and runs. Tintable (white base - classic colours: #1f2a22 green-black, #20232a, #5a1414 red, #1c2f4a blue). Lamp posts, benches, bollards, pumps, pillar boxes. WEAR chips to dark iron; special = rust bleeding.

materials.name: iron_rusty
materials.desc: Heavily rusted, pitted, flaking iron in oranges and dark browns. Old tools, anchors, drain grates, neglected fittings. wear = dark polished iron.

materials.name: zinc
materials.desc: Dull grey galvanised / zinc sheet with spangle and white bloom. Buckets, watering cans, gutters, downpipes, roof flashing. special = rust.

materials.name: brass
materials.desc: Aged brass: warm yellow metal with brown tarnish in recesses and fine polishing lines. Tintable (#ffffff brass; #f2c9a0 copper-ish; #e6d9c0 nickel). Lantern fittings, door furniture, bells, clock bezels, taps. wear = bright polished; special = verdigris.

materials.name: bronze_aged
materials.desc: Dark statuary bronze, chocolate-brown patina with green in recesses and rubbed golden highlights. Statues, fountain spouts, plaques, bells. special = verdigris.

materials.name: lead
materials.desc: Soft dull blue-grey lead sheet with white oxide bloom and dents. Flashing, window cames, cistern linings, roof finials.

materials.name: canvas
materials.desc: Heavy cotton canvas, plain weave, slight slub and creasing. Tintable (off-white base). Awnings, market stall covers, sacks, tarps, banners. Optional stripes: mat('canvas', '#a33', stripe=0.12, tint2='#eee4cf') paints stripes across U. special = sun-fade.

materials.name: burlap
materials.desc: Coarse open-weave jute sacking, hairy. Sacks, wrapped bundles, root balls. Tintable.

materials.name: rope
materials.desc: Three-strand twisted hemp rope: U runs ALONG the rope (sweep() gives this), strands spiral. Lashings, well ropes, mooring coils. Tintable.

materials.name: leather
materials.desc: Worn vegetable-tanned leather: fine pebbled grain, creases, darkened handling. Tintable (#7a4a2a tan default look, #2a1c14 dark). Straps, luggage, bellows, book spines, seats. wear = pale scuffs.

materials.name: paper
materials.desc: Aged laid paper / parchment: fibres, foxing, soft creases. Tintable (cream base). Posters, notices, lantern shades, labels, maps. special = damp stains.

materials.name: terracotta
materials.desc: Unglazed fired clay: orange-buff, throwing lines, lime bloom, small chips. Tintable. Flower pots, chimney pots, individually modelled roof tiles, ridge tiles, urns. special = moss/algae.

materials.name: ceramic_glazed
materials.desc: Glossy glazed ceramic / enamel with fine crazing and pooled glaze. Tintable (white base). Tiles, jugs, crockery, enamel signs, glazed pots, insulators. wear = chipped to biscuit clay.

materials.name: chalkboard
materials.desc: Black slate chalkboard with wiped chalk dust smears and ghosted writing. Cafe menu boards, A-frames. Tintable (dark green boards).

materials.name: wax
materials.desc: Candle wax / tallow: soft translucent ivory with drips. Tintable. Candles, seals.

materials.name: moss
materials.desc: Dense cushion moss, deep green to yellow-green. Use as a solid material on modelled moss clumps / tufts between stones.

materials.name: hedge
materials.desc: Dense small-leaf foliage surface (box / privet): layered tiny leaves with dark gaps. For clipped hedge volumes, topiary shells, dense ivy masses, far tree canopies. Tintable (autumn / bluish).

materials.name: leaf
materials.desc: Single broad leaf blade: midrib, veins, slight gloss; the albedo is a generic green blade filling the tile - map each modelled leaf / petal quad to the whole tile or model leaf outlines in geometry. Tintable (greens, autumn colours, petals: any flower colour).

materials.name: plain
materials.desc: Matte neutral surface in the tint colour with fine micro-roughness. LAST RESORT for things with no better library material (rubber, bone, plastic-like bakelite). Assets made mostly of 'plain' are rejected.

materials.name: metal_plain
materials.desc: Clean metal in the tint colour (gold leaf #d4a84b, chrome #dddddd, tin, gunmetal). params: rough (default 0.35).

materials.name: glass_clear
materials.desc: Clear window / bottle glass, thin, slightly wavy, reflective. Tint = glass colour (#ffffff clear, #9fd6c0 bottle green, #7a4a1e amber). params: opacity (default 0.25), rough.

materials.name: glass_frosted
materials.desc: Frosted / etched glass: bright diffusing surface. Lamp globes and shades. Tint = colour; params: glow (emissive strength if lit from inside, 0 = unlit), opacity.

materials.name: glass_lantern
materials.desc: Old seeded lantern glass, faint amber, lit from within (subtle glow so the panes read warm at night). params: glow (default 1.2), opacity (default 0.35).

materials.name: glass_stained
materials.desc: Stained glass panel glowing from interior light; tint = glass colour per piece (use several mats). params: glow (default 2).

materials.name: window_lit
materials.desc: Glazing of an OCCUPIED room at night: warm interior seen through slightly wavy glass with a faked room depth (parallax), curtains and soft variation per pane. Tint = interior light colour (default #ffc37a). params: glow (default 3), curtain (0..1 how drawn the curtains are). Put behind modelled glazing bars.

materials.name: window_dark
materials.desc: Glazing of a dark room: near-black, glossy, reflects the lantern light and sky, faint curtain shapes. For unlit windows (mix lit and dark ones!).

materials.name: emissive
materials.desc: Self-luminous surface: flames, gas mantles, bulb filaments, glowing embers, lit signs. Tint = colour (#ffb45e flame, #ffd9a0 mantle, #fff1d0 bulb). params: glow (2 = dim ember, 8 = lantern flame, 20+ = dazzling bulb). Always pair with a light() socket.

materials.name: neon
materials.desc: Neon / glass tube lettering: saturated emissive core with soft falloff. Tint = gas colour (#ff3b6b, #37e0ff, #ffd24a). params: glow (default 10).

materials.name: water
materials.desc: Moving water surface: animated ripples, reflective, slightly green-dark. Fountain basins, troughs, puddles, canal. params: flow (ripple speed, default 1), tint for depth colour, opacity.

materials.name: water_fall
materials.desc: Falling / jetting water sheet or stream: streaky, semi-opaque white-blue, scrolls along +U. Fountain jets and spill sheets, gargoyle spouts. params: flow.
